text: This report is filed regarding the account of Hira Shah (CNIC 470131-5558507-7), a student with a declared monthly income of PKR 30,000, whose activity exhibits classic money mule characteristics. Between April 3 and April 11, 2026, the account received 15 distinct inbound IBFT transfers totaling approximately PKR 938,000 from numerous unrelated individuals, including Sadia Aslam, Fahad Abbas, and Kashif Nawaz. This volume is significantly disproportionate to the customer's declared income and occupation. The funds were rapidly swept out of the account via two large wallet transfers to QuickPay wallet ***0932 (PKR 273,000 on April 5 and PKR 336,000 on April 11) and ATM withdrawals at Blue Area, Islamabad (PKR 273,000 on April 8 and PKR 28,000 on April 11). The pattern of high-volume, rapid pass-through of funds from multiple sources to a single wallet and cash outlets is indicative of layering illicit proceeds. Furthermore, the Fraud Desk noted that two sender banks issued fraud recall requests citing scam complaints, suggesting the inbound transfers may be related to online fraud schemes. The customer’s risk rating is low, and no legitimate business or personal reason for this transactional behavior has been identified.
